versions.localizedDescription:
Reynard TV 0.2.0, build 11 (GeckoView 159.0.20261022150525)

# Reynard TV changelog

## Unreleased: TV browser foundation

### Fixed
- Toolbar remains visible during normal TV browsing, tab switching, address submission and menu actions.
- Pressing D-pad Down from the toolbar now focuses the webpage without dismissing the navigation controls.
- Toolbar can be hidden explicitly from the menu, and restored via Menu or Back; fullscreen video still hides it temporarily.

### Added
- Remote-friendly settings menu with search engine selection, homepage URL, desktop/mobile switching and website color scheme.
- Local browsing history and history clearing, excluding private tabs.
- Private tab creation and bookmark deletion controls.
- GeckoView add-on management: signed XPI installation with permission approval, listing, enable/disable, updates and uninstall.
- Add-on options pages (including Gecko's internal moz-extension URLs) and a Mozilla Add-ons discovery link.
- In-app GitHub update checks comparing published APK build numbers with the installed version; direct update APK download to the TV Downloads folder.
- Gecko-authenticated downloads to the system Downloads provider on modern Android, with an in-memory transfer status list.
- Experimental FetchDock direct-URL transfers: four validated HTTP byte-range segments when the server supports strong ETags and identity coding, with safe single-stream fallback.
- Find-in-page and autoplay/DRM/tracking protection controls.
- Selective clearing of Gecko website cookies, caches, sessions and permissions; fixes for private tabs accidentally persisting the last URL or opening non-private popup tabs.

### Not yet included
- Mozilla Account sign-in, Firefox Sync engines and Android credential integration.
- Interception of ordinary authenticated downloads for segmented FetchDock processing, durable background transfers and persistent transfer queue.
- Fully featured site permission management, reading mode and custom launcher icon picker.

The Android TV branch is a separate Kotlin application: iOS-specific Swift features must be
ported to Android rather than directly merged from `firefox-account-sync`.

apps.name: Amazon Music TV Plus
apps.subtitle: Amazon Music port for Android TV
apps.localizedDescription: Android TV adaptation of Amazon Music, with supported audio passthrough and TV-friendly controls.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Changes
- Replaced the fixed stereo reduction with an automatic PCM loudness leveler.
- Measures rolling PCM RMS level and continuously adjusts gain toward a configurable target.
- Uses slow attack and release smoothing to reduce audible pumping.
- Limits automatic gain to -12 through +6 dB and respects PCM peak headroom to reduce clipping.
- Added target presets on Now Playing and a -24 through -12 dBFS target slider under Audio output.
- Displays live input dBFS, target and applied gain in Audio output diagnostics.

## Passthrough protection
The analyzer and gain processor run only in Amazon's decoded PCM write path. DD+, E-AC3/JOC Atmos, Dolby Digital, IEC61937 and MPEG-H passthrough bypass it and remain at unity gain.

## Verification
- Confirmed the PCM write hook is present in the final classes15.dex.
- APK signature v3 and zip alignment verified.
- Signing certificate SHA-256: 99bec8a3a491133fc24e245459b5c5c2a5bddbf2b7fdff498808bcd8c78d6125
- APK SHA-256: 0bc0991f518c2604c4a3c785fd0eca6b01deb2587352866e33581c2021f3645e

versions.localizedDescription:
## Changes
- Repeat is now handled by TV Plus because Amazon rejects the standard MediaSession repeat command.
- Repeat One restarts the current track; Repeat All restarts the exposed queue or browsed track list.
- Playable cards such as My Likes now open a detail page and require an explicit Play selection instead of starting immediately.
- Added a visible volume-leveler control to Now Playing with Off, 3, 6, 9 and 12 dB stereo/PCM reduction presets.
- Go to Artist and Go to Album now use Amazon catalog search rather than the unavailable library-browse path.
- Replaced the broken Search route with Amazon's native deep-link search handler and external search fallback.

## Audio behavior
The leveler reduces decoded stereo/PCM only. DD+/Atmos and MPEG-H passthrough remain unchanged so encoded spatial audio is not altered.

## Verification
- APK signature v3 verified.
- Signing certificate SHA-256: 99bec8a3a491133fc24e245459b5c5c2a5bddbf2b7fdff498808bcd8c78d6125
- APK SHA-256: 2e7753d64d56b60f090151a77ad9262c0125e6854d12c01ef46a186868ec21b3

Build 5 for ARM32 Google TV. Install over build 4; package com.amazon.mp3 and the private signing certificate are unchanged.

Changes:
- Hold OK on a card or control to jump straight to the mini-player. Menu/Info also jumps there; Up or Back restores the previous focus without scrolling through the library.
- Add Screen off to the mini-player, full-screen player, media notification and floating dock. Default OLED black mode needs no setup and keeps the TV awake with black pixels. OK/Back restores the picture; media and volume keys remain available.
- Optional Sony Picture off mode uses the TV's localhost API and existing IP-control key when required. Configure it under Settings, or hold OK on the mini-player Screen off button. It falls back to black mode when unavailable.
- Add playback-only CPU/Wi-Fi wake locks and screen/standby event history in Audio output.

Power/standby limitation: the remote Power button remains controlled by Sony/Android. Continued HDMI/eARC audio during actual standby is not guaranteed or hardware-tested. Use Screen off when standby interrupts playback.

Validation: Java compiled; ZIP integrity, version, launchers, ABI, zipalign and APK v3 signature checked. All 17 existing playback dex files and 52 native libraries match the user-confirmed Atmos build 4 byte-for-byte. Changes:
- Report the original player's observed AudioTrack encoding, routed device, sample rate, channels, offload state and underruns.
- Distinguish the selected Atmos/JOC source from the observed Android output.
- Move repeated diagnostic reads off the UI thread; reduce repeated PiP, media-session, text and artwork work.
- Hide the floating dock while the TV activity is visible.
